summary: Section A of the TICO Statistical Plan establishes general reporting rules for Texas residential property insurance experience beginning April 1, 2026. It defines monthly reporting obligations and deadlines, TICO’s role as TDI’s designated statistical agent, report categories for premiums, losses, cancellation/nonrenewal/declination notices, actual counts, claim-count/status logic, private flood reporting, TWIA depopulation reporting, and several code lists used in the plan.

proposed_nodes.name: Homeowners Policies
proposed_nodes.notes: Scope coverage/form group for the Plan.

proposed_nodes.name: Dwelling Coverage
proposed_nodes.notes: Amount of insurance reported for homeowners, dwelling, and condominium forms, including qualifying alterations and improvements for condominium forms.

proposed_nodes.name: Personal Property Coverage
proposed_nodes.notes: Amount of insurance reported for homeowners, dwelling, tenant, and condominium forms as applicable.

proposed_nodes.name: Loss of Use Coverage
proposed_nodes.notes: Includes Additional Living Expense; percentage limits must be converted to dollar amounts for reporting.

proposed_nodes.name: Private Flood Coverage
proposed_nodes.notes: Report indicator 1 if coverage for flood or rising waters is provided; NFIP Write Your Own and stand-alone excess flood policies are excluded.

proposed_nodes.name: Replacement Cost Building Coverage
proposed_nodes.notes: Report whether dwelling/building coverage is replacement cost or ACV, including endorsements and functional replacement cost treatment.

proposed_nodes.name: Replacement Cost Contents Coverage
proposed_nodes.notes: Report whether personal property coverage is replacement cost or ACV, including endorsements and functional replacement cost treatment.

proposed_nodes.name: Roof Coverage Type
proposed_nodes.notes: Report roof coverage as replacement cost or ACV; declining payment schedules are reported as ACV.

proposed_nodes.description: Values used to identify newly reported claims, previously reported claims, and reversals of new-claim reporting.

proposed_nodes.description: Values used to identify first payment, nonpayment/subsequent payment records, and reversals of paid-claim reporting.

proposed_nodes.name: Reopened Claim Count Code List

proposed_nodes.name: Claim Status Code List
proposed_nodes.description: Claim status values distinguishing open/closed status, indemnity payment history, and whether a claim was previously reported as closed.

proposed_nodes.name: Prior Claims History Code List
proposed_nodes.description: One-digit code for number of chargeable claims on the policy in the previous five years, or company nonuse of prior claims history.
proposed_nodes.notes: Rule 20 incorporates exclusions from 28 TAC §§21.1004 and 21.1007 and Insurance Code §544.353 for chargeable claims.

proposed_nodes.name: Tenure Code List
proposed_nodes.description: One-digit numeric code for tenure with insurer used when an insurer rates or tiers based on tenure.

proposed_nodes.name: Wind-Only Line of Business Code List
proposed_nodes.description: Line of business codes applicable to wind-only policies in TWIA depopulation and voluntary-market contexts.

proposed_nodes.name: Private Flood Coverage Indicator Code List
proposed_nodes.description: Indicator for whether a policy provides private flood or rising-water coverage.
proposed_nodes.notes: Only indicator value 1 is expressly defined in Rule 32.

proposed_nodes.name: Line of Business Code 13 — TWIA-Originated Wind-Only Policies
proposed_nodes.description: Applies to all policies originally issued by TWIA, including policies later assumed by a take-out insurer through assumption reinsurance.

proposed_nodes.name: Line of Business Code 14 — Required Renewals of Assumption Reinsurance Policy
proposed_nodes.description: Applies to the first, second, and third renewal of an assumption reinsurance policy that the take-out insurer is required to renew under Texas Insurance Code §2210.703(a).

proposed_nodes.name: Line of Business Code 15 — Other Wind-Only Policies
proposed_nodes.description: Applies to all other wind-only policies, including voluntary TWIA take-outs, fourth and subsequent renewals of AR policies, and other voluntary-market wind-only policies.

proposed_nodes.name: Private Flood Coverage Indicator 1 — Provides Private Flood or Rising-Water Coverage
proposed_nodes.description: Policy provides coverage for flood or rising waters, whether within the policy or by premium-bearing or nonpremium-bearing endorsement.
proposed_nodes.notes: Also used when private flood or rising-water coverage excludes storm surge or wave surge.
